engagement_background.objective: Generate $240-$470K in cost savings through a six-month strategic sourcing initiative that leverages Savida Health’s enterprise-wide purchasing power while maintaining or improving service levels, product quality, and payment terms.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Approximately $5.3 million of indirect spend across 10 categories (EMR, employee benefits, lab supplies, medical supplies, small-parcel shipping, IT hardware, telecom, office supplies, commercial print, waste management) is in scope; low-opportunity categories may be dropped as the project progresses.
constraints_challenges: Supplier lack of responsiveness to data requests
Supplier pushback and risk of uncoordinated “side conversations” without a unified communication strategy
Limited internal line-item usage data, requiring direct supplier data pulls
Key stakeholder availability and potential pushback during data collection and review cycles
Aggressive timeline: quick-hit savings by end of 2024 and full project completion by mid-March 2025
Incumbent supplier sensitivities that must be managed respectfully during competitive sourcing

procurement_environment.data_availability: Basic AP / purchasing data exists, but detailed line-item usage often must be obtained from suppliers; contracts are held locally and need to be collected.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: No centralized spend visibility; historical usage data is incomplete and scattered, requiring significant cleanup and external supplier input to build baselines.
